clips.title: The story
paras: In central Ashenvale, Bloodtooth Camp lies west of the Falfarren River. Ran Bloodtooth leads the corrupted furbolgs, who attack anyone who approaches. Alliance scouts target the camp as they work to cleanse the surrounding woodlands.

Bloodtooth Camp lies southwest of the southern Moonwell and west of the Falfarren River. Its furbolgs were once bound to Kalimdor's sacred wilderness, but a lingering spiritual corruption has consumed their tribe. Ran Bloodtooth commands the crude settlement. His followers attack travelers and night elven protectors alike.
